grammarFocus: 比较级；最高级；方式与时间介词；how long / how often。
title: A Day in the City: Transport and Life
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。短文和问题都是模拟材料，不是真实考试。请仔细阅读，答案必须来自短文。
passage:
Li Wei lives in a small town near Shanghai. He often visits the city for work. Last Saturday, he went to the city by train. The train was faster than the bus. It took only thirty minutes. The bus takes about one hour. So Li Wei prefers the train.

In the city, Li Wei uses the subway to travel around. The subway is the fastest way to get around the city. It is also cheaper than taking a taxi. Li Wei usually takes the subway twice a day. He spends about forty minutes on the subway each day.

Li Wei likes to visit the city library. The city library is the biggest library in the city. It is open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. every day. Li Wei goes there once a week. He usually stays for two hours. He reads books and sometimes meets friends.

On Saturday, Li Wei also went to a new shopping mall. The mall is more modern than the old one. It has many shops and restaurants. Li Wei bought a new bag. He paid 200 yuan for it. He thinks the new mall is better than the old one.

Li Wei usually goes to the city by train. He thinks the train is the most comfortable way to travel. He often goes to the city on weekends. He sometimes stays overnight in a hotel. The hotel is near the train station. It is very convenient.

questions.explanation: 短文第一段明确说：'Last Saturday, he went to the city by train.' 所以答案是 By train。
questions.evidence: Last Saturday, he went to the city by train.

questions.prompt: How long does the train take?
questions.explanation: 短文第一段说：'It took only thirty minutes.' 这里的 It 指火车，所以火车需要三十分钟。

questions.prompt: Which library is the biggest in the city?
questions.explanation: 短文第三段说：'The city library is the biggest library in the city.' 所以城市图书馆是最大的。
questions.evidence: The city library is the biggest library in the city.

questions.prompt: How often does Li Wei go to the city library?
questions.explanation: 短文第三段说：'Li Wei goes there once a week.' 所以是每周一次。
questions.evidence: Li Wei goes there once a week.

questions.prompt: How much did Li Wei pay for the new bag?
questions.explanation: 短文第四段说：'He paid 200 yuan for it.' 所以是200元。

questions.prompt: What does Li Wei think is the most comfortable way to travel?
questions.explanation: 短文最后一段说：'He thinks the train is the most comfortable way to travel.' 所以是火车。
questions.evidence: He thinks the train is the most comfortable way to travel.

questions.prompt: The new shopping mall is more modern than the old one.
questions.explanation: 短文第四段说：'The mall is more modern than the old one.' 所以这个说法是正确的。
questions.evidence: The mall is more modern than the old one.

questions.prompt: Li Wei usually goes to the city by bus.
questions.explanation: 短文最后一段说：'Li Wei usually goes to the city by train.' 所以这个说法是错误的。
questions.evidence: Li Wei usually goes to the city by train.

questions.explanation: 短文最后一段说：'He sometimes stays overnight in a hotel.' 所以这个说法是正确的。
questions.evidence: He sometimes stays overnight in a hotel.

questions.prompt: Li Wei usually takes the subway ______ a day. (用数字或单词填空)
questions.explanation: 短文第二段说：'Li Wei usually takes the subway twice a day.' 所以填 twice。
questions.evidence: Li Wei usually takes the subway twice a day.

grammar.title: 比较级、最高级、方式与时间介词、how long / how often
grammar.explanation: 比较级用于比较两个事物，常加 -er 或 more，如 faster, more modern。最高级用于三个或以上事物中最突出的，常加 -est 或 most，如 the fastest, the most comfortable。方式介词 by 表示交通方式，如 by train, by bus。时间介词 at 用于具体时间点，如 at 9 a.m.；on 用于星期几，如 on Saturday；from...to... 表示从……到……。how long 问时间长度，如 How long does it take? how often 问频率，如 How often do you go?
grammar.example: The train was faster than the bus.

questions.prompt: The subway is ______ than the bus.
questions.explanation: 比较级用 faster，因为句子中有 than。
questions.evidence: The subway is faster than the bus.

questions.prompt: This is the ______ library in the city.
questions.explanation: 最高级用 biggest，因为句子中有 the 和 in the city 表示范围。
questions.evidence: This is the biggest library in the city.

questions.prompt: I go to school ______ bus every day.
questions.explanation: 交通方式用 by，如 by bus。
questions.evidence: I go to school by bus every day.

questions.prompt: ______ do you go to the library? — Once a week.
questions.explanation: 问频率用 How often，回答是 Once a week。
questions.evidence: How often do you go to the library? — Once a week.
